117812134: The Meeting of Napoleon I and Tsar Alexander I at Tilsit is an 1808 history painting by the French artist Adolphe Roehn. It depicts the scene on 25 June 1807 when Napoleon met with Alexander I of Russia on a raft in the middle of the River Neman.
The Meeting of Napoleon I and Tsar Alexander I at Tilsit
129990128: Napoleon's Bivouac on the Battlefield of Wagram is an 1810 history painting by the French artist Adolphe Roehn. It depicts a scene from the Battle of Wagram during the War of the Fifth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars.
Napoleon's Bivouac on the Battlefield of Wagram
